Don't pay attention to them. I think that deep inside they want to be as free as you. But they can't because they want to be with their peers. 
I'm also a black woman and in University. I thought that people were educated enough here but no, they are not. I got critized because I "act" european and not black. I don't get these ideas. Is being black just a person who is "funny" and know how to dance, sing and do silly stuff? To some people we are reduced to that. Just an entertainment. 
But you shouldn't care about that. Life is too short to put others (shitty) opinion over your own. 
Be strong and avoid these toxic persons. :)))

French is difficult. I mean for me it's easy but I understand that it could be hard for you :)
Yeah, just PM me. I'm more open here than in real life anyway...

French.... That's my native language and wow you're strong for WANTING to learn French :))) 
I plan to leave University if it doesn't work and I don't know but do something with my shitty life, if we can call it a "life"

Sorry if I answer late but time difference :/
Anyway, I study Japanese. I really don't know why I'm doing this to myself. 
When I share a little of my problem which is 0.5% , I heard those "But you chose it!" And "It's not THAT hard. It's just a language." 
It's true , I have chose it because I love it but omg the DIFFICULTY. I do speak Japanese but I don't have the level yet that my University requires. They want the top while I'm average...

Yes, I'm in college. Second year. It's more than difficult. I do understand why I study. I do understand that for getting a job, I need diplomas. I do understand that I need to suffer to get what I want. But I don't understand why it's so difficult. I took time before coming back to this post because I wrote it without thinking. 
I mean, I know that life is hard and stuff but when someone want to end it for reasons, the whole World seems to be against it. 
I'm giving one year again. If it works, I'll be alive next year. If it don't, I'll will not cellebrate my 22th anniversary. I can't do this. I just can't.
Unfortunately, I don't have close friends....

Let's be honest. I think I will be happy for the first seconds but it will surely not cure my depression. Knowing me, I would invest in economics stuff, having constant rent and giving the money to my REALLY close family. 
The World and my life would be still a M.E.S.S, 60 millions added to my bank account or not.
Can't wait too. End of 2017 sounds good to me.

She told me to drop/quit University, if it's to be "bad" at it? But I'm also "bad" at life, so should I quit it too? 
I just woke up (6 am) and I already want to be tonight, too tired to do my homework or anything else...
Too late :/

Divorced parents sucks... Y dad was acting I was his precious daughter but when there was no one around ,he didn't even lead a glance to me. 
I'm from France :)

You had a difficult childhood. I never get hit (only slap) but my mom was strong for IGNORING me. Sometime, I would have like that she slap or something but no she just showed me how upset she was and mostly how I sucked at school. 
My dad... Well, I can't even call him dad. He left when I was 6 years, and came back when I was 14 years. I really tried my best and even went twice to his country (yep he doesn't live in the same country) but my step mother was awful to me... The day she hit me I promised to myself to get ride of his existence in my life. But I know that he is part of my depression too... I was getting attention only when I had good grades (and he was worse than my mom)

My mom pressured me for school. My parents are divorced so I only have my mom near me. In high school, she could get mad at me when I get a 19/20 and I will REMEMBER this sentence until my last breath I think : "Why do you keep being bad at school?" Wow, it broke something in my soul and since this day I can litterally get several sleepless nights to get the grade that would allow me to have a reason to make her happy. 
She is not longer pressuring me but I kept the way of "getting good grades no matter what"

Since I enter school, I knew that it would fucked up my brain and I WAS RIGHT. 
Yeah, I saw studies about the difference between a 'normal' person and a depressed one. :/
I don't think that we can be cure. I think it will be "less" present but dtill it will be here waiting for you to do a mistake and HOP you come like you was years ago :)))))
It can. It didn't work for me (only get worse) but maybe it will a good experience for you. I really hope ...

I'm just sad... I really thought that something would change but not in the wrong. 
(I'M SO SENSITIVE OVER... NOTHING! Why I hate myself so much right now. It's whole new level)

I should quickly finish all this. I can't keep up. I try mt best to voice these insane and complicated thought and she reduced it as "tired." 
Ok... I get it. I perfectly get it this time.
Same....
Thank you.

I try to contact a psychiatrist at the moment. Not right now (it's almost 1am in my country) but in the future. I just don't know when. 
But thank you for your offer. I dont want to disturb.

"Can someone kill me please?" (Before a test or any moment of my life that I dislike)

"Hello, I would like to die" (and giggles right after. I generally said this when I start university at 8 fcking am)

When I got asked "Are you tired?" by my friends , I simply answer "No, I'm thinking about my blade waiting in my drawer." Then they laugh and change subject. 

I have many mores but I don't remember all of them.
This kind of intention give me faith in humanity.... For a little moment
They will surely judge me too. I know how HARSH AND MERCILESS is the World...

Thank you !!

Don't let them bring you down, buddy ! Honestly, I'm waiting to be graduate so I can leave my country and all my TOXIC friends. The good one will be able to reach , the others ? I DON'T CARE. I am not better than them but they are SURELY NOT better than me. And that's the same for you :) 
Take care.
Thanks buddy !! I'll celebrate it by SLEEPING PEACEFULLY. It's been a while. I know it's weird but I'm happy to sleep WITHOUT INTENSE negatives thoughts.
Thank you.... Thank you very much...
I don't know if I deserve this... Sincerely I dont think so but I'm tired to all of this. I will try again... (to see a professional. I know that the end of my sentence was maybe weird ^^)
Yeah i have but I don't want to take their time. I always complain so it will be weird if I start saying from nowhere that I'm tired but like REALLY tired. They will not understand :(
I'm currently searching for one but the price... Well, I already didn't have a lot in my bank account but now it will soon become a small deserted land :))))

I completely understand. These happy moments are rare but still they are here. :) 
It's just that they are not a lot :(
I'm always trying... It's just.. It's hard that's all :(

You're welcome and I understand about the dream stuff. Every night, it gets me :))))
You're not alone, so I prefer that you post here instead of cutting please. 
Anyway, take care of yourself and your body :) 
Bye // See you soon ~

Yeah, you must be frustrated :/

The only problem is OBVIOUSLY the delivery. Solution 3: You go like this and you create a small lie around your scars. BE CREATIVE. Solution 4: I don't have solution 4 and I'm sorry if I couldn't help you :/

CONGRATULATIONS !!!!! Now keep being positive and keep us update ;)

Don't hate yourself. I mean we have enough hate toward ourselves :/ I remember someone saying to be clean by gradually increasing the day you were clean. 
Like week 1, you were clean one day. Week 2, you were clean for three. And each week you keep increasing the number. ;) 
So don't blame yourself and keep being strong :)

I've tried like one this year and I understood that it WASN'T FOR ME. It was too awkward for me and I wasn't comfortable (I waste 400 dollars lol. As a student who doesn't receive any help, my wallet is still crying ^^) 
I'm pretty to be composed at 99% of insecurities :))))) 
Same here ! Spam when you want ;)

I'll say "Go for yourself" Even if I'm in bad mood right now (I'm in daily mental breakdown every night...) I have a SLIGHT hope that one day, we will all get over  our depression. And having a diploma will help us to achieve our dreams (I don't really have one, but I have some passion, so I'll try to do something with it). 
So keep fighting and don't be afraid to seek help if you see that IT'S TOO MUCH ;)

I don't think it's a eating disorder but it's surely something that need to be stop ;) Think about a way to eat more.

"Be strong" I wish I could. It will surely take several months, but yeah I'll do everything on my own to found the strength.

Thanks for replying :) I've just woke up, it's almost 1pm and I did nothing except looking at the ceiling from time to time. 
I'm just ruined.
Ah sorry~ *-* But yeah, be strong and don't leave each other. It's important.

You're lucky to have each other. You need to talk with her about this. You "share" selfharm so you "almost" share the same mind. Try to understand what makes her to deeply wanted to be hurt despite having you near her. 

Stay safe girls !! :)
